passage.en: even when sick, they always use "I'm busy" or "I don't have time" as an excuse and won't go to hospital.

passage.zh: 專家指出，這是因為男性經常以「東西勉強可用就不必修理」的心態來面對健康問題，即使身體有小病痛也刻意忽略，害怕一去看醫師就會發現許多毛病，或者就此必須終生吃藥度日。
passage.py: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, zhè shìyīnwèi nánxìng jīngcháng yǐ “Dōngxi miǎnqiǎng kěyòng jiù búbì xiūlǐ” de xīntài lái miànduì jiànkāng wèntí, jíshǐ shēntǐ yǒu xiǎo bìngtòng yě kèyì hūlüè, hàipà yí qù kàn yīshī jiù huì fāxiàn xǔduō máobìng, huòzhě jiùcǐ bìxū zhōngshēng chīyào dùrì.
passage.en: Experts point out that this is because men often face health problems with the attitude "if something still more or less works, there's no need to fix it." Even when they have minor ailments they deliberately ignore them, afraid that a visit to the doctor will uncover many problems, or that they'll then have to take medicine for the rest of their lives.

passage.zh: 壽命長短男女有別，這其中包含了許多如遺傳或體質方面等先天因素。

passage.en: Life expectancy differs between men and women, and this includes many innate factors such as heredity and constitution.

passage.zh: 但許多專家認為，與其說這種差距與男性基因有關，倒不如說與男人對健康的態度有關。
passage.py: Dàn xǔduō zhuānjiā rènwéi, yǔqíshuō zhèzhǒng chājù yǔ nánxìng jīyīn yǒuguān, dàobùrúshuō yǔ nánrén duì jiànkāng de tàidù yǒuguān.

passage.zh: 有一種鳥叫蜂鳥，是鳥類中最小的鳥，只有拇指大小。
passage.py: Yǒu yìzhǒng niǎojiào fēngniǎo, shì niǎolèi zhōng zuìxiǎo de niǎo, zhǐyǒu mǔzhǐ dàxiǎo.
passage.en: There is a bird called the hummingbird, the smallest of all birds—only the size of a thumb.

passage.zh: 這種鳥嘴型細長，專吃花蜜和花上的小昆蟲，產於南美洲，整日盤旋於仙人掌等幾種花間，也許營養太單調，總也吃不大、飛不高。
passage.py: Zhèzhǒng niǎozuǐ xíng xìcháng, zhuān chī huāmì Héhuā shàng de xiǎo kūnchóng, chǎnyú Nánměizhōu, zhěngrì pánxuán yú xiānrénzhǎng děng jǐzhǒng huājiān, yěxǔ yíngyǎng tài dāndiào, zǒng yě chī búdà, fēi bù gāo.
passage.en: This bird has a long thin beak and feeds only on nectar and small insects on flowers. It comes from South America and hovers all day among a few kinds of flowers such as cactus flowers; perhaps because its diet is too monotonous, it never grows big or flies high.

passage.zh: 而有些人讀書做學問的方式，和蜂鳥很相似。
passage.py: Ér yǒuxiē rén dúshū zuòxuéwèn de fāngshì, hé fēngniǎo hěn xiāngsì.
passage.en: The way some people study and pursue learning is very similar to the hummingbird.

passage.zh: 這些人愛讀書，卻不大會讀書，往往成為書的奴僕，他們埋進書堆，一心只讀自己的書，任天塌下來也不管。
passage.py: Zhèxiē rén ài dúshū, què bú dàhuì dúshū, wǎngwǎng chéngwéi shū de núpú, tāmen máijìn shūduī, yìxīn zhǐdú zìjǐ de shū, rèn tiāntāxiàlái yě bùguǎn.
passage.en: These people love reading but aren't good at reading; they often become slaves of books. They bury themselves in piles of books, single-mindedly reading only their own books, not caring even if the sky falls.

passage.zh: 這些人埋頭苦讀，精神可嘉，本無可厚非，然而令人擔心的是鑽進象牙塔出不來。
passage.py: Zhèxiē rén máitóu kǔdú, Jīngshénkějiā, běn wúkěhòufēi, rán'ér lìngréndānxīn de shì zuānjìn Xiàngyátǎ chūbùlái.
passage.en: Their dedication to study is admirable and beyond reproach, but the worrying thing is that they burrow into an ivory tower and can't get out.

passage.zh: 讀書就像吃飯，不可偏食，印刷的書籍要讀，人生這本大書更得讀。
passage.py: Dúshū jiù xiàng chīfàn, bùkě piānshí, yìnshuā de shūjí yàodú, rénshēng zhèběn dàshū gèng dédú.
passage.en: Reading is like eating: you mustn't be a picky eater. Printed books should be read, and even more the great book of life.

passage.py: Shàng cèsuǒ gāi yòng shénmeyàng de wèishēngzhǐ ne?
passage.en: What kind of toilet paper should we use?

passage.zh: 說起來只是小事一樁，對環境而言卻有莫大的影響。
passage.py: Shuō qǐlái zhǐshì xiǎoshìyìzhuāng, duì huánjìng éryán què yǒu Mòdà de yǐngxiǎng.
passage.en: It sounds like a trivial matter, but it has an enormous impact on the environment.

passage.zh: 環保專家指出，超柔軟衛生紙儘管用起來舒服，對環境的破壞卻更甚於耗油的汽車或垃圾食物。
passage.py: Huánbǎo zhuānjiā zhǐchū, chāo róuruǎn wèishēngzhǐ jǐnguǎn yòng qǐlái shūfú, duì huánjìng de pòhuài què gèng shényú hàoyóu de qìchē huò lājī shíwù.
passage.en: Environmental experts point out that although ultra-soft toilet paper is comfortable to use, it does even more damage to the environment than gas-guzzling cars or junk food.

passage.zh: 由於原始木材的長纖維較易展開且膨鬆，易於製造非常柔軟的衛生紙，因此市面上出售的超柔軟衛生紙大多來自原始森林，再加上紙漿製造過程會使用大量的化學藥品，人們若經常使用這類衛生紙，得付出很大的環境成本。
passage.py: Yóuyú yuánshǐ mùcái de cháng xiānwéi jiàoyì zhǎnkāi qiě péngsōng, yìyú zhìzào fēicháng róuruǎn de wèishēngzhǐ, yīncǐ shìmiànshàng chūshòu de chāo róuruǎn wèishēngzhǐ dàduō láizì Yuánshǐsēnlín, zài jiāshàng zhǐjiāng zhìzào guòchéng huì shǐyòng dàliàng de huàxuéyàopǐn, rénmen ruò jīngcháng shǐyòng zhè lèi wèishēngzhǐ, děi fùchū hěndà de huánjìng chéngběn.
passage.en: Because the long fibers of virgin wood spread out and fluff up more easily, making very soft toilet paper easy to produce, most ultra-soft toilet paper on the market comes from old-growth forests. On top of that, the pulping process uses large amounts of chemicals, so if people regularly use this kind of toilet paper, a heavy environmental cost must be paid.

passage.zh: 其實在歐洲及拉丁美洲，有不少廠商會以回收木材來製造衛生紙，但許多人仍認為用回收品做出的衛生紙品質差、硬如紙板、難以使用，甚至會損傷肌膚，其實這是一種迷思。
passage.py: Qíshí zài Ōuzhōu jí Lādīngměizhōu, yǒu bùshǎo chǎngshānghuì yǐ huíshōu mùcái lái zhìzào wèishēngzhǐ, dàn xǔduō rén réng rènwéi yòng huíshōu pǐn zuòchū de wèishēngzhǐ pǐnzhì chà, yìngrú zhǐbǎn, nányǐshǐyòng, shènzhì huì sǔnshāng jīfū, qíshí zhè shì yìzhǒng mísī.
passage.en: In fact, in Europe and Latin America many manufacturers make toilet paper from recycled wood, but many people still think toilet paper made from recycled material is poor quality, as hard as cardboard, hard to use and may even damage the skin. In fact this is a myth.

passage.zh: 綠色和平組織已發出文宣來抵制紙業公司所宣傳的超柔軟衛生紙，呼籲人們重視衛生紙產品的選擇，畢竟，人們每次使用衛生紙的時間可能只有三秒鐘，實在沒有必要為了所謂的舒適感而犧牲珍貴的生態環境。

passage.en: Greenpeace has issued publicity material to boycott the ultra-soft toilet paper promoted by paper companies, calling on people to pay attention to their choice of toilet paper products. After all, each time people use toilet paper may be only three seconds; there is really no need to sacrifice the precious ecological environment for so-called comfort.

passage.zh: 自兩億多年前的侏儸紀之初，體型巨大就是陸生動物的普遍特點。
passage.py: Zì liǎngyìduōnián qián de zhū luó Jìzhīchū, tǐxíng jùdà jiùshì lùshēngdòngwù de pǔbiàn tèdiǎn.
passage.en: Since the beginning of the Jurassic period more than two hundred million years ago, huge size has been a common feature of land animals.

passage.zh: 動物為什麼要長成巨無霸呢？
passage.py: Dòngwù wèishénme yào zhǎngchéng Jùwúbà ne?
passage.en: Why do animals grow into giants?

passage.zh: 有些理由是顯而易見的：身軀愈大愈不易被獵殺，而且還利於撲殺獵物。
passage.py: Yǒuxiē lǐyóu shì xiǎn'éryìjiàn de: Shēnqū yùdàyù búyì bèi lièshā, érqiě hái lìyú pūshā lièwù.
passage.en: Some reasons are obvious: the bigger the body, the harder it is to be hunted, and it also helps in killing prey.

passage.zh: 例如羚羊很容易淪為獅子、土狼和獵犬的獵物；
passage.py: Lìrú língyáng hěn róngyì lúnwèi shīzi, tǔláng hé lièquǎn de lièwù;
passage.en: For example, antelopes easily fall prey to lions, hyenas and hunting dogs;

passage.zh: 但成象及犀牛則幾乎不受威脅，牠們的子女也因父母體型巨大而得到保護。
passage.py: Dàn chéngxiàng jí xīniú zé jīhū bú shòu wēixié, tā men de zǐnǚ yě yīn fùmǔ tǐxíng jùdà ér dédào bǎohù.
passage.en: but adult elephants and rhinos are almost never threatened, and their young are also protected by their parents' huge size.

passage.zh: 對草食動物來說，長得巨大表示「高人一等」，可以吃到更高處的樹葉。
passage.py: Duì cǎoshídòngwù láishuō, zhǎng de jùdà biǎoshì “Gāorényìděng”, kěyǐ chīdào gèng gāochù de shùyè.
passage.en: For herbivores, growing huge means being "a head taller than others," able to eat leaves higher up.

passage.zh: 長頸鹿及大象就有長到五公尺高的，而大象尚可利用龐大的身軀推倒高樹。
passage.py: Chángjǐnglù jí dàxiàng jiù yǒu zhǎng dào wǔ gōngchǐ gāo de, ér dàxiàng shàngkě lìyòng pángdà de shēnqū tuīdào gāoshù.
passage.en: Giraffes and elephants can grow up to five meters tall, and elephants can also use their massive bodies to push over tall trees.

passage.zh: 其他重要卻不明顯的理由有：運動消耗的能量會隨體型增大而減少，故一隻五公噸重的大象走一公里路所消耗的能量，比一群總重五公噸的瞪羚走同樣路程要少很多。
passage.py: Qítā zhòngyào què bù míngxiǎn de lǐyóu yǒu: Yùndòng xiāohào de néngliàng huì suí tǐxíng zēngdà ér jiǎnshǎo, gù yìzhī wǔ gōngdūn zhòng de dàxiàng zǒu yì gōnglǐ lù suǒ xiāohào de néngliàng, bǐ yìqún zǒng zhòngwǔ gōngdūn de dèng língzǒu tóngyàng lùchéng yào shǎo hěnduō.
passage.en: Other important but less obvious reasons are: the energy used in movement decreases as body size increases, so a five-ton elephant walking one kilometer uses much less energy than a herd of gazelles weighing five tons in total walking the same distance.

passage.zh: 此外，新陳代謝率也會隨體型增大而降低。
passage.py: Cǐwài, xīnchéndàixiè lǜ yě huì suí tǐxíng zēngdà ér jiàngdī.
passage.en: In addition, metabolic rate also falls as body size increases.

passage.zh: 這就是為什麼鼩鼱每天都得吞入超過其體重的食物，而大象只需吃進占體重 5％的食物便足矣。
passage.py: Zhè jiùshì wèishénme qú jīng měitiān dōu děi tūnrù chāoguò qí tǐzhòng de shíwù, ér dàxiàng zhǐ xū chī jìnzhàn tǐzhòng 5 ％ de shíwù biàn zúyǐ.
passage.en: This is why a shrew has to eat more than its body weight in food every day, while an elephant needs only food equal to 5% of its body weight.

passage.zh: 不僅如此，龐大的身體也具有像隔熱板一樣的保溫作用，讓動物不受環境劇烈溫差的影響。
passage.py: Bùjǐnrúcǐ, pángdà de shēntǐ yě jùyǒu xiàng gérèbǎn yíyàng de bǎowēn zuòyòng, ràng dòngwù bú shòu huánjìng jùliè wēnchà de yǐngxiǎng.
passage.en: Not only that, a massive body also keeps warm like a heat shield, protecting the animal from sharp swings in environmental temperature.

passage.zh: 不過，長得巨大也是有害處的。
passage.py: Búguò, zhǎng de jùdà yě shì yǒu hàichù de.
passage.en: However, growing huge also has drawbacks.

passage.zh: 因為大的動物吃得多，其總數自然有限。
passage.py: Yīnwèi dà de dòngwù chī de duō, qí zǒngshù zìrán yǒuxiàn.
passage.en: Because big animals eat a lot, their total numbers are naturally limited.

passage.zh: 非洲的大象及犀牛數目，在人類獵捕之前也不過是以百萬計；
passage.py: Fēizhōu de dàxiàng jí xīniú shùmù, zài rénlèi lièbǔ zhīqián yě búguò shì yǐ bǎiwànjì;
passage.en: Before humans hunted them, African elephants and rhinos numbered only in the millions;

passage.zh: 相對地，齧齒類動物的數量則不知有幾十億。
passage.py: Xiāngduì de, nièchǐlèidòngwù de shùliàng zé bùzhī yǒu jǐshíyì.
passage.en: by contrast, rodents number who knows how many billions.

passage.zh: 此外，小動物鑽地洞、上樹、飛天等動作，龐然大物也很難望其項背。
passage.py: Cǐwài, xiǎo dòngwù zuān dìdòng, shàng shù, fēitiān děng dòngzuò, pángrándàwù yě hěn nán wàngqíxiàngbèi.
passage.en: In addition, giants can hardly match small animals at burrowing, climbing trees or flying.

passage.en: Or is it better to develop them jointly with other companies?

passage.zh: 根據愛薩得商學院的報告，答案主要取決於產品本身的複雜度。
passage.py: Gēnjù Àisàdé Shāngxuéyuàn de bàogào, dá'àn zhǔyào qǔjuéyú chǎnpǐn běnshēn de fùzádù.
passage.en: According to a report by INSEAD business school, the answer depends mainly on the complexity of the product itself.

passage.zh: 報告指出，複雜度很高或很低的產品，較不適合與他人合作；
passage.py: Bàogào zhǐchū, fùzádù hěn gāo huò hěndī de chǎnpǐn, jiào bú shìhé yǔ tārén hézuò;
passage.en: The report points out that products of very high or very low complexity are less suited to working with others;

passage.zh: 但是複雜度居中的產品，如果與其他企業聯手，可能會比公司本身單打獨鬥來得好。
passage.py: Dànshì fùzádù jūzhōng de chǎnpǐn, rúguǒ yǔ qítā qǐyè liánshǒu, kěnéng huì bǐ gōngsī běnshēn dāndǎdúdòu lái de hǎo.
passage.en: but for products of medium complexity, joining forces with other companies may be better than a company going it alone.

passage.zh: 這是因為在開發簡單的產品時，公司本身就能找出最佳的設計方向或是解決技術問題，考慮和其他企業合夥根本是多此一舉；
passage.py: Zhè shìyīnwèi zài kāifā jiǎndān de chǎnpǐn shí, gōngsī běnshēn jiù néng zhǎochū zuìjiā de shèjì fāngxiàng huòshì jiějué jìshù wèntí, kǎolǜ hé qítā qǐyè héhuǒ gēnběn shì duōcǐyìjǔ;
passage.en: This is because when developing simple products, the company itself can find the best design direction or solve technical problems, so considering a partnership with other companies is completely superfluous;

passage.zh: 而開發複雜度高的產品，如果和同業合作，可能由於細節繁多，理念差異過大，在研發或行銷過程中經常產生歧見，反而大幅降低效率。
passage.py: Ér kāifā fùzádù gāo de chǎnpǐn, rúguǒ hé tóngyè hézuò, kěnéng yóuyú xìjié fánduō, lǐniàn chāyì guò dà, zài yánfā huò xíngxiāo guòchéng zhōng jīngcháng chǎnshēng qíjiàn, fǎn'ér dàfú jiàngdī xiàolǜ.
passage.en: while for highly complex products, if you work with others in the industry, the many details and big differences in ideas may often cause disagreements during R&D or marketing, greatly lowering efficiency instead.

passage.zh: 至於像個人電腦這一類複雜度居中的產品，尋求合作的伙伴往往比閉門造車來得好。
passage.py: Zhìyú xiàng gèréndiànnǎo zhè yílèi fùzádù jūzhōng de chǎnpǐn, xúnqiú hézuò de huǒbàn wǎngwǎng bǐ bìménzàochē lái de hǎo.
passage.en: As for products of medium complexity like personal computers, seeking partners is often better than working behind closed doors.

passage.zh: 報告指出，在開發這一類產品時，儘管過程中的爭辯、歧見不可避免，但是多聽聽合作伙伴提出的構想，有利於刺激靈感、分享創意，還可以一起進行市場調查、快速掌握消費動向，好處遠遠超過意見不合所產生的負面效應。
passage.py: Bàogào zhǐchū, zài kāifā zhè yílèi chǎnpǐn shí, jǐnguǎn guòchéng zhōng de zhēngbiàn, qíjiàn bùkěbìmiǎn, dànshì duō tīngtīng hézuòhuǒbàn tíchū de gòuxiǎng, yǒulìyú cìjī línggǎn, fēnxiǎng chuàngyì, hái kěyǐ yìqǐ jìnxíng shìchǎng diàochá, kuàisù zhǎngwò xiāofèi dòngxiàng, hǎochù yuǎnyuǎn chāoguò yìjiàn bùhé suǒ chǎnshēng de fùmiànxiàoyìng.
passage.en: The report points out that when developing this kind of product, although arguments and disagreements are unavoidable, listening to partners' ideas helps spark inspiration and share creativity; you can also do market research together and quickly grasp consumer trends. The benefits far outweigh the negative effects of disagreement.

passage.en: After reading Professor Bao's new book "Wishing You Happiness This Year," I realized those can only count as fleeting joy, not something real and lasting.

passage.zh: 誠如書中所言：「快樂是一種遍布在生命之中，滿足和幸福的感受，而喜悅則像煙火，稍縱即逝。」
passage.py: Chéngrú shū zhōng suǒ yán: “Kuàilè shì yìzhǒng biànbù zài shēngmìng zhīzhōng, mǎnzú hé xìngfú de gǎnshòu, ér xǐyuè zé xiàng yānhuǒ, shāozòngjíshì.”
passage.en: As the book says: "Happiness is a feeling of contentment and well-being that pervades life, while joy is like fireworks—gone in an instant."

passage.zh: 或許你認為這道理誰都懂，然想遠比做容易。
passage.py: Huòxǔ nǐ rènwéi zhè dàolǐ shuí dōu dǒng, rán xiǎng yuǎn bǐzuò róngyì.
passage.en: Perhaps you think everyone understands this, but thinking is far easier than doing.

passage.zh: 這本書告訴我們兩件事：快樂是需要練習的；
passage.py: Zhè běnshū gàosù wǒmen liǎngjiànshì: Kuàilè shì xūyào liànxí de;
passage.en: This book tells us two things: happiness needs practice;

passage.zh: 再則，追兔子的狗，比躺在門廊上睡覺的狗更快樂！
passage.py: Zàizé, zhuī tùzi de gǒu, bǐ tǎng zài ménláng shàng shuìjiào de gǒu gèng kuàilè!
passage.en: and secondly, a dog chasing a rabbit is happier than a dog sleeping on the porch!

passage.zh: 這原理並非為捉到兔子能令人快樂，而是當我們為突破挑戰與困境而忙碌時，往往能從中發現自己的才能，找出更多存在的價值。
passage.py: Zhè yuánlǐ bìngfēi wèi zhuōdào tùzi néng Lìngrén kuàilè, érshì dāng wǒmen wèi tūpò tiǎozhàn yǔ kùnjìng ér mánglù shí, wǎngwǎng néng cóngzhōng fāxiànzìjǐ de cáinéng, zhǎochū gèng duō cúnzài de jiàzhí.
passage.en: The principle isn't that catching the rabbit makes us happy, but that when we're busy breaking through challenges and difficulties, we often discover our own talents and find more value in our existence.

passage.zh: 這也說明了為何許多不需要克服難題的有錢人，其實並不快樂。
passage.py: Zhè yě shuōmíng le wèihé xǔduō bù xūyào kèfú nántí de yǒuqiánrén, qíshí bìng bú kuàilè.
passage.en: This also explains why many rich people who don't need to overcome difficulties aren't actually happy.

passage.zh: 這讓我想起《國家科學院期刊》一項調查結果，他們發現 50％的快樂，由快樂的設定點決定，生活條件只佔 10％，剩下的 40％則取決於行動。
passage.py: Zhè ràng wǒ xiǎngqǐ «Guójiā kēxuéyuàn qīkān» yíxiàng diàochájiéguǒ, tāmen fāxiàn 50 ％ de kuàilè, yóu kuàilè de shèdìng diǎn juédìng, shēnghuó tiáojiàn zhǐ zhàn 10 ％, shèngxià de 40 ％ zé qǔjuéyú xíngdòng.
passage.en: This reminds me of a survey result in the "Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences": they found that 50% of happiness is determined by a happiness set point, living conditions account for only 10%, and the remaining 40% depends on action.

passage.en: It's like a pilot weighing a few dozen kilograms flying a plane weighing hundreds of thousands of kilograms: heavy and powerful as the plane is, it flies only in the direction the pilot guides it.

passage.zh: 最近我依著鮑教授的建議，開始練習微笑，心中同時想著「我很快樂」，也似乎真找出了環境或生活中讓自己快樂的事，看來此法確實值得大家一試。

passage.en: But from my own practical experience, there's one thing to watch out for: never say "I want to be happy."

passage.zh: 2008 年的斯德哥爾摩水資源獎，頒給了提出「虛擬水」概念的東尼艾倫教授。
passage.py: 2008 nián de Sīdégē'ěrmó shuǐzīyuán jiǎng, bāngěi le tíchū “Xūnǐ shuǐ” gàiniàn de Dōngní Àilún jiàoshòu.
passage.en: The 2008 Stockholm Water Prize was awarded to Professor Tony Allan, who proposed the concept of "virtual water."

passage.zh: 所謂的「虛擬水」，是指食品或消費品在生產及銷售過程中所需要的用水量。
passage.py: Suǒwèi de “Xūnǐ shuǐ”, shì zhǐ shípǐn huò xiāofèipǐn zài shēngchǎn jí xiāoshòu guòchéng zhōng suǒ xūyào de yòngshuǐliàng.
passage.en: "Virtual water" refers to the amount of water needed in producing and selling food or consumer goods.

passage.zh: 這概念指出，人們不僅在飲用和淋浴時需要水，在消費其他產品時也會消耗大量的水。
passage.py: Zhè gàiniàn zhǐchū, rénmen bùjǐn zài yǐnyòng hé línyù shí xūyào shuǐ, zài xiāofèi qítā chǎnpǐn shí yě huì xiāohào dàliàng de shuǐ.
passage.en: The concept points out that people need water not only for drinking and showering, but also consume large amounts of water when they consume other products.

passage.zh: 例如，一杯咖啡在種植、生產、包裝和運輸的過程中，得消耗 140 升的水，這相當於一個英國人平均每天飲用和家庭生活的用水量。
passage.py: Lìrú, yìbēi kāfēi zài zhòngzhí, shēngchǎn, bāozhuāng hé yùnshū de guòchéng zhōng, děi xiāohào 140 shēng de shuǐ, zhè xiāngdāngyú yí ge Yīngguórén píngjūn měitiān yǐnyòng hé jiātíng shēnghuó de yòngshuǐliàng.
passage.en: For example, a cup of coffee uses 140 liters of water during growing, production, packaging and transport—equivalent to the average daily water use of a British person for drinking and household life.

passage.zh: 「虛擬水」的概念進一步說明了「虛擬水」的交易模式，這對全球的貿易政策及水資源利用產生了重大影響。
passage.py: “Xūnǐ shuǐ” de gàiniàn jìnyíbù shuōmíng le “Xūnǐ shuǐ” de jiāoyì móshì, zhè duì quánqiú de màoyì zhèngcè jí shuǐzīyuán lìyòng chǎnshēng le zhòngdà yǐngxiǎng.
passage.en: The concept of "virtual water" further explains the trading model of "virtual water," which has had a major impact on global trade policy and water resource use.

passage.zh: 這項理論指出，氣候潮濕地區的農業，多半會利用廉價的自然降雨，而非成本高昂的灌溉系統，因此能大幅降低農業的生產成本。
passage.py: Zhèxiàng lǐlùn zhǐchū, qìhòu cháoshī dìqū de nóngyè, duōbànhuì lìyòng liánjià de zìrán jiàngyǔ, ér fēi chéngběn Gāo'áng de guàngàixìtǒng, yīncǐ néng dàfú jiàngdī nóngyè de shēngchǎnchéngběn.
passage.en: The theory points out that agriculture in humid regions mostly uses cheap natural rainfall rather than costly irrigation systems, and can therefore greatly reduce agricultural production costs.

passage.zh: 這些地區可以通過農作物，將水資源「出口」到較為炎熱乾旱的國家。
passage.py: Zhèxiē dìqū kěyǐ tōngguò nóngzuòwù, jiāng shuǐzīyuán “Chūkǒu” dào jiàowéi yánrè gānhàn de guójiā.
passage.en: These regions can "export" water resources to hotter, drier countries through crops.

passage.zh: 而氣候向來乾旱的國家，則可以「進口」需水量很大的農作物，紓緩國內水資源不足的壓力。
passage.py: Ér qìhòu xiànglái gānhàn de guójiā, zé kěyǐ “Jìnkǒu” xūshuǐliàng hěndà de nóngzuòwù, shū huǎn guónèi shuǐzīyuán bùzú de yālì.
passage.en: And countries with dry climates can "import" water-intensive crops, relieving the pressure of insufficient domestic water.

passage.zh: 儘管檯面上的交易只看得到農產品，實際上卻包括了水資源的交換。
passage.py: Jǐnguǎn tái miànshàng de jiāoyì zhǐ kàn dédào nóngchǎnpǐn, shíjìshàng què bāokuò le shuǐzīyuán de jiāohuàn.
passage.en: Although only agricultural products are visible in the trade, it actually includes an exchange of water resources.

passage.zh: 舉例來說，在埃及，已經有越來越多的傳統食品是由進口糧食所製造的，反而不是尼羅河所灌溉種植的小麥。
passage.py: Jǔlìláishuō, zài Āijí, yǐjīng yǒu yuèláiyuè duō de chuántǒng shípǐn shì yóu jìnkǒu liángshí suǒ zhìzào de, fǎn'ér búshì Níluóhé suǒ guàngài zhòngzhí de xiǎomài.
passage.en: For example, in Egypt, more and more traditional foods are made from imported grain rather than from wheat irrigated by the Nile.

passage.zh: 如果埃及堅持所有的穀物都由自己種植，很快就會面臨水資源不足的窘境。
passage.py: Rúguǒ Āijí jiānchí suǒyǒu de gǔwù dōu yóu zìjǐ zhòngzhí, hěnkuài jiù huì miànlín shuǐzīyuán bùzú de jiǒngjìng.
passage.en: If Egypt insisted on growing all its grain itself, it would soon face a water shortage.

passage.zh: 世界水資源週所提出的報告也使用了這一個概念，指出當前世界性的糧食危機在於過於浪費，而非生產不足。
passage.py: Shìjiè shuǐzīyuán Zhōu suǒ tíchū de bàogào yě shǐyòng le zhè yí ge gàiniàn, zhǐchū dāngqián shìjièxìng de liángshí wēijī zàiyú guòyú làngfèi, ér fēishēngchǎn bùzú.
passage.en: A report from World Water Week also used this concept, pointing out that the current global food crisis lies in excessive waste rather than insufficient production.

passage.zh: 因為一份糧食從生產、加工、運輸、儲存、販賣以至於烹煮，每一環節都要消耗水資源，要是消費者丟棄買回來的食物，也意味著浪費了生長、運送、貯存過程中所使用的水。
passage.py: Yīnwèi yífèn liángshí cóng shēngchǎn, jiāgōng, yùnshū, chǔcún, fànmài yǐzhìyú pēngzhǔ, měiyī huánjié dōu yào xiāohào shuǐzīyuán, yàoshì xiāofèizhě diūqì mǎihuílái de shíwù, yě yìwèizhe làngfèi le shēngzhǎng, yùnsòng, zhùcún guòchéng zhōng suǒ shǐyòng de shuǐ.
passage.en: Because every step of a portion of food—production, processing, transport, storage, sale and cooking—consumes water, if consumers throw away food they've bought, it also means wasting the water used in growing, transporting and storing it.

passage.zh: 專家表示，唯有避免浪費食物，才能有效落實節水政策。
passage.py: Zhuānjiā biǎoshì, wéiyǒu bìmiǎnlàngfèi shíwù, cáinéng yǒuxiào luòshí jiéshuǐ zhèngcè.
passage.en: Experts say only by avoiding food waste can water-saving policies be effectively implemented.

passage.zh: 我的朋友老張買了份終身壽險、附加手術醫療保險，希望在有生之年若患病、遭逢意外時，能獲得醫療補助或理賠。
passage.py: Wǒ de péngyǒu lǎozhāng mǎi le fèn zhōngshēn shòuxiǎn, fùjiā shǒushù yīliáobǎoxiǎn, xīwàng zài yǒushēngzhīnián ruò huànbìng, zāoféng yìwài shí, néng huòdé yīliáo bǔzhù huò lǐpéi.
passage.en: My friend Lao Zhang bought a whole-life insurance policy with surgical medical cover, hoping that if he fell ill or had an accident during his lifetime, he could get medical subsidies or compensation.

passage.zh: 然而，前年老張因白內障而動手術，事後向保險公司申請保險金，卻被擋在門外。
passage.py: Rán'ér, qiánnián lǎozhāng yīn báinèizhàng ér dòngshǒushù, shìhòu xiàng bǎoxiǎngōngsī shēnqǐng bǎoxiǎnjīn, què bèi dǎng zài ménwài.
passage.en: However, the year before last Lao Zhang had an operation for cataracts, and when he later applied to the insurance company for the payout, he was turned away.

passage.zh: 保險專員表示，手術醫療被保險人在接受手術治療後，必須住在醫院始能獲得保險金，而張先生治療白內障屬於當天完成的手術，無法提供任何補助。
passage.py: Bǎoxiǎn zhuānyuán biǎoshì, shǒushù yīliáo bèibǎoxiǎnrén zài jiēshòu shǒushù zhìliáo hòu, bìxū zhù zài yīyuàn shǐ néng huòdé bǎoxiǎnjīn, ér Zhāng xiānsheng zhìliáo báinèizhàng shǔyú dàngtiān wánchéng de shǒushù, wúfǎ tígōng rènhé bǔzhù.
passage.en: The insurance agent said that, under the surgical medical cover, the insured must be admitted to hospital after surgery to receive the payout, and Mr. Zhang's cataract treatment was day surgery, so no subsidy could be provided.

passage.zh: 老張對此當然忿忿不平，他認為，以往白內障手術的確得住院，不過現今醫學發達，手術完後即可離開，根本不必住院、浪費醫療資源！
passage.py: Lǎozhāng duìcǐ dāngrán fènfènbùpíng, tā rènwéi, yǐwǎng báinèizhàng shǒushù díquè děi zhùyuàn, búguò xiànjīn yīxué fādá, shǒushù wán hòu jíkě líkāi, gēnběn búbì zhùyuàn, làngfèi yīliáo zīyuán!
passage.en: Lao Zhang was naturally indignant. He argued that cataract surgery used to require hospitalization, but with today's advanced medicine you can leave right after the operation—there's no need to be admitted and waste medical resources!

passage.zh: 老張於是向保險事業發展中心提出申訴，希望透過合法途徑獲得理賠。
passage.py: Lǎozhāng yúshì xiàng bǎoxiǎn shìyè fāzhǎn zhōngxīn tíchū shēnsù, xīwàng tòuguò héfǎ tújìng huòdé lǐpéi.
passage.en: So Lao Zhang filed a complaint with the Insurance Development Center, hoping to get compensation through legal channels.

passage.zh: 保險事業發展中心認為，老張確實沒住院，也無需住院，手術實際狀況不符條款約定要件而未獲給付，依約保險公司並無推諉塞責的情況，老張在這場抗爭中其實站不住腳。
passage.py: Bǎoxiǎn shìyè fāzhǎn zhōngxīn rènwéi, lǎozhāng quèshí méi zhùyuàn, yě wúxū zhùyuàn, shǒushù shíjì zhuàngkuàng bùfú tiáokuǎn yuēdìng yàojiàn ér wèihuò jǐfù, yīyuē bǎoxiǎngōngsī bìng wú tuīwěi sèzé de qíngkuàng, lǎozhāng zài zhèchǎng Kàngzhēng zhōng qíshí zhànbúzhùjiǎo.
passage.en: The Insurance Development Center found that Lao Zhang indeed wasn't hospitalized and didn't need to be, the actual circumstances of the surgery didn't meet the conditions in the policy, so no payment was made; under the contract the insurance company hadn't shirked responsibility, and Lao Zhang actually had no leg to stand on in this dispute.

passage.zh: 老張不服申訴結果，故透過網路散播不利於保險公司的評論。
passage.py: Lǎozhāng bùfú shēnsù jiéguǒ, gù tòuguò wǎnglù sànbō búlìyú bǎoxiǎngōngsī de pínglùn.
passage.en: Lao Zhang didn't accept the result of the complaint, so he spread comments online unfavorable to the insurance company.

passage.zh: 爾後，保險公司針對老張的這些言論提出惡意誹謗的控訴。
passage.py: Ěrhòu, bǎoxiǎngōngsī zhēnduì lǎozhāng de zhèxiē yánlùn tíchū èyì fěibàng de kòngsù.
passage.en: Afterwards, the insurance company sued him for malicious defamation over these remarks.

passage.zh: 如此一來一往，造成兩敗俱傷。
passage.py: Rúcǐ yìláiyìwǎng, zàochéng liǎngbàijùshāng.
passage.en: This back and forth left both sides harmed.

passage.zh: 我認為保險公司堅守合約條款，對，也不對。
passage.py: Wǒ rènwéi bǎoxiǎngōngsī jiānshǒu héyuē tiáokuǎn, duì, yě bú duì.
passage.en: I think the insurance company sticking to the terms of the contract is both right and wrong.

passage.zh: 也許在「理」方面確實站得住腳，然而，站在「情」方面未免有失人情味、過於冷血。
passage.py: Yěxǔ zài “Lǐ” fāngmiàn quèshí zhàndézhùjiǎo, rán'ér, zhàn zài “Qíng” fāngmiàn wèimiǎn yǒushī rénqíngwèi, guòyú lěngxuè.
passage.en: Perhaps in terms of "reason" it's on solid ground, but in terms of "human feeling" it's rather lacking in warmth and too cold-blooded.

passage.zh: 保險公司應該將眼光放遠，網開一面，與當事人溝通協調，最好能主動提供些微補助，如能不拘泥於明文規定，我相信定能提升自身形象，也能使人受惠、創造雙贏。
passage.py: Bǎoxiǎngōngsī yīnggāi jiāng yǎnguāng Fàngyuǎn, wǎngkāiyímiàn, yǔ dāngshìrén gōutōng xiétiáo, zuìhǎo néng zhǔdòng tígōng xiēwēi bǔzhù, rú néng bù jūnìyú míngwénguīdìng, wǒ xiāngxìn dìng néng tíshēng zìshēn xíngxiàng, yě néng shǐ rén shòuhuì, chuàngzào Shuāngyíng.
passage.en: The insurance company should take the long view, show some leniency, communicate and negotiate with the person concerned, and ideally offer a small subsidy on its own initiative. If it didn't stick so rigidly to the written rules, I believe it would certainly improve its image, benefit people and create a win-win.
